I cannot buy chemical fertilizer for land that is not my own, and it is too costly anyway, but I will carry cow dung and compost from my compound to spread on the plot before planting. I have kept good seed from my last harvest to sow, and my children and I will clear, plant, and weed with our own hands since we have no money for sprays or machines. I will hire two young men from the village for a few days only at harvest when the work is heaviest, and we depend on the rains because there is no water for irrigation here.
